items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: all Ricardo--- recordings that I did with that band

ctx.x: -- because it seemed to work itself around with (unintelligible) the band they were all young kids and they knew a lot of -- about jazz from hearing it. But they were Latins and their rhythm was all Latin, all Ricardo--- recordings that I did with that band was strictly jazz solos. The first one I made with him -- with the band called, "Halla-Halla" and the band they had been together quite a few years, I'd say three or four years before and the recording that I made with them of "Halla-Halla" the band went right…
Well did you ever really enjoy playing Latin music, or was it?
